high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Reddit post by the user "u/IllustriousDudeIDK" made 14 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post discusses the 1884 US Presidential Election, highlighting that it was the first time a Democrat won the White House since the Civil War. The main content of the post is a map titled "United States Presidential Election Results by County (1884)." The map uses color coding to represent the results of the election across different counties in the United States. The legend on the right side of the map indicates the following color codes: Light blue
